Name: Oasis Greenhouse - Expanded
Author: Gh0stPredd
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is a Patch for the legendary mod that is the "Oasis Greenhouse" made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url]. This patch now allows 20 trees to be placed into the greenhouse rather than the 16 from the default mod. This allows the ability to place expansion saplings from SVE, Ridgeside and also East Scarp (Should it be applicable) to also be placed inside the greenhouse alongside the original saplings.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Because of the expanded Saplings from the expansion mods, if you want all the saplings from them inside the expanded greenhouse, you are only limited to 1 of the saplings only, otherwise there won't be enough space in the orchard.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This is my first mod ive uploaded on here so please let me know of any issues or requests and ill try to get it uploaded. Otherwise thank you for looking and/or downloading and i hope you enjoy the patch :)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This mod has everything that is included with the original mod, just expands only on the Orchard. You also have the option to go back to the standard size from the Original Mod or use the extended version.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b][size=4]Please Note:[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]If you have Extended mode on and don't want to use the Cellar then use the this Mod's config to disable or enable. If you have Standard enabled, use the Original Mod Config.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install the Mod via Vortex or Manually however you normally install mods on Stardew.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=3]If Installing Manually:[/size][/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]download and install the required Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]extract [CP] Oasis Greenhouse - Extended Orchard folder to Stardew Valley/Mods[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]run the game with SMAPI[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Expands the Orchard area to allow 20 tree saplings rather than the default 16. This is to allow Expanded Saplings from SVE and Ridgeside to be planted in the Greenhouse.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿- Latest Version Recommended (Oasis Mod says 2.11.0)[/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][color=#d4d4d8]﻿ - 2.0 or higher (Oasis Mod says 1.6 or higher)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3969]Oasis Greenhouse[/url] by Daisy Niko (Strictly Required)[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs / Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url] - A massive thank you for creating the original mod and kindly granting permission to upload this expanded orchard patch! [/color][/*]
[/list]
